data.message: I individually commit to request 18 tons; this opt-in isn't contingent on unanimity. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, that's 500 or 100: risky, not guaranteed long-run optimal. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Each of you: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others? You may choose 18 even if others choose 10.
